subject: Discovery Recap: Dedicated Capacity for Aurora Finance
messages:
From: Derek Liu <derek.liu@aurorafin.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Discovery call recap / priorities

Hi Rafael / Marissa,

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from Aurora Finance's side and a few clarifications:

- Pain points:
  - Latency variability during batch close windows (spikes up to 600ms affecting throughput)
  - Cost unpredictability as models scale; waste from small-batch inference
  - Data isolation needs for PII-containing models (must meet internal segmentation rules)

- Current stack:
  - Inference: self-hosted PyTorch models on g4dn instances behind a Kubernetes service
  - Frontend: Node.js API, 50 TPS baseline, bursts up to 120 TPS during batch windows
  - Auth/Secrets: AWS KMS

- Success criteria for a Dedicated solution:
  - Predictable p95 latency < 200ms for 8k token prompts
  - Guaranteed baseline throughput of 60 TPS with 2x burst capability
  - Customer-managed VPC + strict key management

I attached a simple infra diagram that shows our inference path.

Next steps from our side: we'd like a technical deep-dive (30-45m) with your infra team and a ballpark pricing for reserved capacity. Also, timeline: we're aiming for a pilot by late July.

Thanks,
Derek Liu
Head of ML Ops
Aurora Finance

Attachment: aurora-infra-diagram.png

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Derek Liu <derek.liu@aurorafin.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Discovery call recap / priorities

Derek — great to chat, thanks for the clear summary. Short recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap / fit:
- Your pain points (latency spikes, cost, isolation) align tightly with what our Dedicated offering addresses.
- Dedicated reserved GPU pools give predictable TPS and p95 latency control; we can isolate workloads in a customer VPC and integrate with AWS KMS/HSM for key management.
- Autoscaling & burst: we support configured baseline capacity with defined burst policies (we can set soft/hard caps and pre-warm nodes for scheduled windows).

Draft success criteria (from today):
- p95 < 200ms @ 8k tokens (we'll validate in pilot)
- Baseline 60 TPS, burst to 120 TPS sustained for up to 30 minutes
- Private VPC + KMS integration, audit logs retained 90 days

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule 45m technical deep-dive with our infra team — attendee suggestions: our runtime lead + your ML Ops engineer
2) We'll provide a preliminary Dedicated capacity config and ballpark pricing (attached: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf)
3) If that looks good, scope a 4-week pilot focusing on the batch-close window and telemetry collection

Available slots for the deep-dive: Wed 6/3 9-11am PT, Thu 6/4 1-4pm PT. What works for you?

I'll loop in Marissa to handle contracting and pilot SOW.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
